messages:
alina: quick canary question — onboarding customer 'oakridge' to our OTLP gateway. They say traces disappear intermittently after a few minutes. where do i start? :thinking_face:

dan: start with gateway logs for 429s / connection resets. also check ingress LB 5xx/timeout counters. any tenant id or sample-rate hint?

alina: tenant=oakridge-17. they used our HTTP/OTLP endpoint (otlp-http.ingress.redwood.internal). sample rate configured client-side = 1. no obvious errors on their side per their support logs.

leo: check otlp-gateway pod logs for grpc status codes & "resource exhausted" or rate limit traces. run: `kubectl -n otlp logs -l app=otlp-gateway --since=15m | grep -E "429|resource exhausted|timeout"`

maya: also pull prometheus metrics from the gateway: `sum(rate(otlp_ingest_requests_total{tenant="oakridge-17"}[5m])) by (code)` and `otlp_ingest_latency_seconds_bucket` to see tail latency. Grafana quick panel: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/ingest/otlp-overview?var-tenant=oakridge-17

samira: small gotcha — if their client retries with identical trace IDs but we drop some spans at the LB, tracing backend can dedupe or show partial traces. check `trace/span_count{tenant="oakridge-17"}` over the last 30m.

alina: i ran the kubectl logs and found a handful of `http: connection reset by peer` and several `429`. posting snippet:
```
[2026-05-10T16:12:01Z] tenant=oakridge-17 level=warn msg="ingest: upstream returned 429" reason="burst limit"
[2026-05-10T16:12:01Z] tenant=oakridge-17 level=info msg="ingest: queued request" queue_len=42
[2026-05-10T16:12:02Z] tenant=oakridge-17 level=error msg="write failed" err="context deadline exceeded"
```

dan: looks like we hit a per-tenant burst throttle. check otlp-rate-limit configuration in k8s configmap: `kubectl -n otlp get cm otlp-config -o yaml` — specifically `burst_per_tenant` and `rate_per_tenant`. If tenant is new, default burst might be low.

leo: while you're at it, validate prom remote write from their Prom endpoint too. If they're sending metrics & traces through same gateway, contention matters. Query: `sum(rate(prom_remote_write_retry_total{tenant="oakridge-17"}[5m]))`

maya: for a fast canary workaround, we can temporarily bump `burst_per_tenant` for oakridge-17 via the configmap and trigger a rolling restart of otlp-gateway deployment. doc: https://wiki.redwood.internal/otlp-onboarding#per-tenant-limits

alina: will try bumping burst to 200 and restart one replica only. pinging @samira to watch traces/fragmentation after change. :pray:

sre-bot: deployment/otlp-gateway rolling restart started by alina (deployment.apps/otlp-gateway) — 1/3 updated.

samira: watching grafana now. if traces come back, we should add a canary dashboard for new tenant onboarding showing: request rate, 429s, queue length, span completeness. I can draft the panel tiles.

alina: ok i see reduced 429s after the restart. traces are reappearing but some spans are still missing in 15-16:12 window. probably client-side retry ordering. maya — can you add a short alert rule: `increase(otlp_ingest_429_total{tenant="oakridge-17"}[5m]) > 0` -> severity=warning during onboarding window.

maya: will add alert targeting #eng-sre with a note to check gateway queue_len and downstream storage write latency.

dan: follow-up: we should add a small onboarding checklist for support/solutions that includes: 1) confirm client using correct endpoint (http vs grpc), 2) check sample rate & batching config, 3) run LB metrics, 4) bump burst if needed, 5) watch Grafana link (embed in playbook).

alina: nice. i'll post the tech checklist in docs and cc @support. thanks all. :thumbsup:
